description: This file defines the LocalDirsForExecutors class, which represents a protocol message used as a reply containing local directory paths for each executor in Spark's shuffle protocol.

classes.name: LocalDirsForExecutors
classes.description: A protocol message class representing local directory paths for executors, including methods for encoding/decoding and comparison.

methods.name: LocalDirsForExecutors
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a map of executor IDs to their local directories.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the message type for this protocol message.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on executor IDs.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.

methods.name: encodedLength
methods.description: Calculates the length of the encoded message.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes the object into a ByteBuf.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a ByteBuf into a LocalDirsForExecutors object.

methods.name: getLocalDirsByExec
methods.description: Returns a map of executor IDs to their local directories.
